name: Deep Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Deep Industries Ltd is in the business of Oil and Gas field services. The company specializes in providing Air & Gas Compression Services, Drilling and Workover Services, Gas Dehydration Services, etc.. The company also provides integrated project management services.[1]
